ex.en: If you can't have children, you could always adopt.
ex.zh: 如果你不能生小孩，還是可以領養。

ex.en: Musical talent can be developed if it's properly trained.
ex.zh: 如果訓練得當，音樂天分是可以培養的。

ex.en: If you have any questions, please call me.
ex.zh: 如果有任何問題，請打電話給我。

ex.en: My physics teacher doesn't care if I skip classes.
ex.zh: 我的物理老師不在乎我是不是翹課。

ex.en: I wonder if you have something to write with.
ex.zh: 不知道你有沒有可以寫字的東西？

ex.en: I'll go even if it rains.
Even if you're busy, please reply to my email.
ex.zh: 即使你很忙，也請回覆我的電子郵件。

ex.en: He talks as if he knows everything.
ex.zh: 他說話的樣子好像什麼都懂。

ex.en: It looks as if it's going to rain.
